Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
The purpose of this procedure is to provide detailed
safe method for substations maintenance staff to minimize the possibility of
error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.
This document outlines the inspection and
maintenance procedures P2
to be performed on frequent intervals every 10 years Y10.
EEC substations engineers in head office and Great Cairo EHV
Network Sector using their background field experience and EEC/OHI/manufacturer
documentation to create this procedure.
Safety Precautions
Combined disconnect switch and earthling switch must
 be isolated and earthling at the two side.
The second combined disconnect switch and earthling
 (Q2) figure 1 must be isolated and earthling.
Isolate the DC voltage.
Tools and Equipment
Set of common keys, torque spring key, screw driver
 set, timing equipment, climb ampere, buzzer, vacuum pump, cleaning material
 (rags, cloth), PVC disposable gloves,
Cleaning fluid.
Ethanol A15 M, Ethanol F25 M.
Electrical grease.
Work to be carried out
Check
 drive and gearbox.
Check
 for proper function of the motor
Check The Transmission And Auxiliary Switch (Figure 2)
With
 the disconnector/ earthing switch in the middle (open) position
Remove
 both control plugs 3223.
Disconnect
 the wiring to the drive motor 3002 the secondary terminal block 3007 of the
 plug.
Mark
 and remove the solenoid 3999 wiring.
Unscrew
 the solenoid base plate 3995 together with the solenoid 3999.
Loosen
 the transmission unit 3010 at the screw 3994
Loosen
 the fixing screws 3992 and remove the cam disc 3993.
Lift
 off the transmission plate 3991 after loosening the nuts 3990 and the
 retaining 3989
Clean
 and grease the transmission according to plan.
Reassemble
 in the reverse order noting the markings.
